responsibility: Defines the ISO convenience interface for retrieving the last read result on the default input channel. It re-exports IOConsts.ReadResults and provides a single accessor, acting as the default-channel analogue of IOResult for code that uses standard input rather than an explicit ChanId.
same_name_distinction: This .def file only publishes the default-input read-result API by re-exporting IOConsts.ReadResults and declaring ReadResult. It differs from SIOResult.mod, which actually fetches the status from IOChan.ReadResult on StdChans.StdInChan.
